Bug: on a weekend the date and the digits drew over each other (Saturday noon: «Пн, 26 Окт» over «45:59:55»; the screen reader heard both). fixed An <svg> has no hidden property: the script now sets the attribute, and the spoken text drops the count when the date stands in its place. Checked with a clock set to Saturday.
Bug: the open note could not be closed with a mouse or a tap (it lay over the «i»). fixed The «i» stands above the note (z-index 2); a click opens and closes it at every width.

Bug: the note overflowed its cell on the narrowest phones and with big text (cut by 6px at 280/320, by 70px at 390 with a 24px text; not centred at 390). fixed The note takes the cell's place in the grid and the countdown's parts keep their own rows, so where it needs more room the cell grows (+43px at 280 and 320, +96 at 390 with 24px text; 0 at 390 and wider); its text is trimmed in its own box, so it is centred by what you see (45 / 45px at 390); the «i» keeps to the top of its row.

Bug: the countdown and the links stopped sharing rows and columns (a container on the countdown turned its subgrid off: from 768 to 999 its parts stacked; elsewhere the rows drifted up to 16px). fixed The caption shrinks by the column's width instead; the rows match the links' to the pixel at 390, 700 and 1280, and the parts stand side by side from 768 to 999.

Bug: the business and about titles grew to 88px (they share --type-display with the old hero title). fixed The home title has its own role, type/hero 48 → 88; type/display stays 40 → 64 (63px at 1440 again).

Visual: between M and L the note is centred on the digits and the caption, not on the whole row (133px right of the row's middle at 800). kept, asked With the parts side by side the «i» ends the first third; centring on the whole row would need a third of air on each side and would make the row grow. Asked in Next.
Visual: the hero links ran 1.6px past their cell at 280. fixed Below S the arrow is 24px and 4px from its text; the links' column is minmax(0, 1fr). 16px from the edge at 280.

Nit: below L the title's padding is wider on the right (the two-words limit was made with padding). changed The title's box is at most two words wide (max-width 11em + the gutters) and its padding is the gutter on every side; the right edge of a wrapped line still leaves air, as any left-aligned text does.
Nit: the L layout starts at exactly 1000px (the column is 929px there, L is 928). answered The shared step L, the same for every block; noted in the report.
Nit: a line under the menu's last cells. answered It is the menu's own edge against the page; the cells have none. Kept, mentioned.
Nit: the full navbar row now starts at 1120. answered In the PR and the report («What this changes»).
Nit: Safari zoomed out on a short screen (the column reaches 1520 before 1616 there, so 1591–1615 has no frame). kept The page condition counts the widest gutter; a short window that wide is rare.
Nit: a comment in motion.css stood on the wrong line. fixed

Checked and correct: the five fades' stops on 0.5, 0, 0.5, 1; the navbar's one group, 8px gaps, 14px grounds, no movement on hover, the home logo; the menu (lines, padding, two columns from 640, the slide, Escape); the hero title 48 → 88, the cells' padding, the frames from 1616, two columns below 768, the entrance (2.2s, no jump at its end), the digits against the spoken time, reduced motion, the keyboard, no sideways scroll from 280 to 2560 and with 24px text, the pager.
